title: Not so fluffy
text: Not so fluffy. Imagine my disappointment when I ordered pillows only to find they were pillow covers, which led me to purchasing these pillows to fill in my newly purchased covers. I was very disappointed to find that these pillows barely filled the cover (yes, the size purchased was correct). The pillows are in the covers, and do go end to end, corner to corner, but there’s just not enough fluff for me. I feel like my pillows have already been used a few years and I just bought them. 😔
